text: On November 9, 2021, the City received an Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendment application for 296-300 King Street East and 56-60 Berkeley Street to permit the construction of a 34-storey mixed-use building with 1,188 square metres of commercial uses and 364 residential units. The applicant appealed City Council's neglect or failure to make a decision on its applications for the Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendments, to the Ontario Land Tribunal on September 26, 2022. The City Solicitor requires further directions for upcoming Ontario Land Tribunal case management conference scheduled for November 4, 2024. This matter is urgent and cannot be deferred.

City Council on October 9 and 10, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 24, 2024) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendix A to the report (September 24, 2024) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 24, 2024) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
